_doc: Referenced time-series sources that data-freshness.test.ts has confirmed are stale but ACCEPTED — the upstream genuinely publishes nothing newer (capped/discontinued), so the chart is as current as the source allows. Each entry needs a reason and, where a fix is pending, a task. A NEW freeze (e.g. a fetch break like oecd/jpn_cpi_yoy) will NOT be here, so the gate fails on it. When a source is fixed or stops being referenced, the gate also fails until its stale entry is removed, so this list cannot rot. (Currently empty: every referenced series is current.)
